parameters.faces: The available face data, in display order.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Whether the control takes focus when it first appears.
parameters.most: The maximum number of individual faces displayed.
parameters.total: The complete count when only some portraits have been loaded.
parameters.size: The diameter of each face in logical pixels.
parameters.label: The text identifying this item or control.
parameters.onPressed: Opens the people behind the group. Null shows the group without a press.
parameters.style: Overrides the component’s themed appearance for this instance.
